paper_title: Knowledge Crosswords Geometric Knowledge Reasoning with Large Language   Models
caption: Problem distribution based on the correctness under the w/ knowledge and w/o knowledge settings using Zero-Shot.
model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of correctness across different problem categories within a knowledge crossword assessment. The chart contains five slices, each representing a distinct category: “easy” colored green and approximately 55.4%, “medium” colored purple and around 58.8%, “hard” colored pink and approximately 37.3%, “Zero-Shot” colored orange and approximately 39.9%, and “N+K-” colored brown and approximately 18.1%. The chart includes percentage labels displayed within each slice, and the slices appear ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area. A legend is provided, indicating the color associated with each category label.
